mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those set of activities undertaken to determine the chemical characteristics and volume of mineral resources so that reserves that are extractable may be outlined."
Prospection and exploration are those set of activities undertaken to determine the chemical characteristics and volume of mineral resources so that reserves that are extractable may be outlined.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of activities undertaken to unravel the existence of natural endowment within the earth."
Exploration is the set of activities undertaken to unravel the existence of natural endowment within the earth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined using geology and geophysical studies while the chemical limits are defined by sampling and composition studies of the resource."
The physical limits are defined using geology and geophysical studies while the chemical limits are defined by sampling and composition studies of the resource.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the naturally occurring inorganic substances that have definite chemical composition and physical character/structure."
Mineralogy is the study of the naturally occurring inorganic substances that have definite chemical composition and physical character/structure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the loss of water in the liquid state to the gaseous state as a result of changes in temperature."
Evaporation is the loss of water in the liquid state to the gaseous state as a result of changes in temperature.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sudden motion of the ground surface, ranging from a faint tremor to a wild motion capable of shaking buildings apart and causing gaping fissures to open in the ground."

Earthquakes/Volcanic Activities An earthquake is a sudden motion of the ground surface, ranging from a faint tremor to a wild motion capable of shaking buildings apart and causing gaping fissures to open in the ground.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lowest part of the atmosphere."
The Troposphere is the lowest part of the atmosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the third planet from the Sun."
The Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for about 84% of the global extent of degraded land."
Water and wind erosion are responsible for about 84% of the global extent of degraded land.
fib: ______ is concerned with the study of all physical features of the earth's surface including its climate and the distribution of plants, animals and human life.
Geography
Geography is concerned with the study of all physical features of the earth's surface including its climate and the distribution of plants, animals and human life.

______ is the most visible effect of erosion in parts of Nigeria underlain by sedimentary rocks while areas underlain by hard basement complex rocks exhibit inselbergs and whalebacks as remnants of erosion.
Gully erosion

Gully erosion is the most visible effect of erosion in parts of Nigeria underlain by sedimentary rocks while areas underlain by hard basement complex rocks exhibit inselbergs and whalebacks as remnants of erosion.
______ is the action of surface processes that removes a part of soil, rock and or dissolved material by wind, water, ice or by gravity from one location of the earth to the other.
Erosion
Erosion is the action of surface processes that removes a part of soil, rock and or dissolved material by wind, water, ice or by gravity from one location of the earth to the other.
______ is the wet or water saturated portions of the earth.
hydrosphere
The hydrosphere is the wet or water saturated portions of the earth.
______ are those natural and man-induced (anthropogenic) processes which create an accident or extreme event or damage to all organisms in the ecosystem.
Environmental hazards
Environmental hazards are those natural and man-induced (anthropogenic) processes which create an accident or extreme event or damage to all organisms in the ecosystem.
______ is the study of the earth; its structure, composition and history.
Geology
Geology is the study of the earth; its structure, composition and history.
______ is the disintegration of rocks due to the actions of water, wind or man.
Weathering
Weathering is the disintegration of rocks due to the actions of water, wind or man.
______ is the uppermost layer of the atmosphere.
Exosphere
Exosphere The Exosphere is the uppermost layer of the atmosphere.
